justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/resolution/Navigator.java` (285 LOC, 22 public static methods, 3 private helpers) plus representative uses in `javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javaparsermodel/TypeExtractor.java` and `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/validator/language_level_validations/Java22Validator.java`. The class is a stateless utility focused on one cohesive concern, AST navigation: type/member lookup, node search, parent traversal, and a few deprecated delegating aliases. The methods are short and grouped around that single purpose, so there is not enough evidence of insufficient modularization.
